_comment: Production options for newapi.woowtech.io. Apply with scripts/newapi_admin.py apply-settings deploy/settings.json. Accounts come from the PaaS only, so every self-service sign-up path and free-credit path is off (GHSA-8r8v: free seed balance made the billing overflow exploitable at scale).
_comment_groups: default = sellable models; internal = ChatGPT-subscription test channel, NOT user-selectable (only accounts whose own group is internal). Model ratios = LiteLLM cost; put markup on GroupRatio.default.
